entries.subject: DAMIT 1173: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 1173, version 2016-01-04, pole (115°, 45°), period 13.8063 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 1174 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 154.334 ± 5.413 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 154.334 ± 5.413 km, from NEOWISE (Grav et al. 2012, ApJ 744, 197; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.subject: Bononia whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 17 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.920 at 462 nm, 1.043 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#383734 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 3.8% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.5%), from NEOWISE (Grav et al. 2012, ApJ 744, 197; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
